realProductFixes.change: Serialize finish_round read/reserve/create/publish and recheck publication under an attempt-scoped native advisory transaction; avoid duplicate terminal cards from concurrent native Message.create calls.
Acquire per-event-loop monitoring transaction gate before borrowing a native PG connection, retaining cross-node advisory locking; prevent pool starvation during 12 simultaneous daily reservations.
